# Careers360

> Careers360 is India's comprehensive education platform providing exam guides, college rankings, admissions counseling, and career resources for engineering and professional entrance exams.

Careers360 offers detailed information on major Indian entrance exams like JEE Main, JEE Advanced, MHT CET, and EAMCET, alongside extensive college listings, rankings, and predictive admission tools. The platform serves as a one-stop resource for students navigating higher education in India.

## Key Topics

- JEE Main
- JEE Advanced
- MHT CET
- AP EAMCET
- TS EAMCET
- KCET
- BITSAT
- IIT colleges
- NIT colleges
- IIIT colleges
- Engineering admissions
- NIRF rankings
- Entrance exams
- Cutoff scores
- Counselling process

## Engineering Entrance Exams

- [JEE Main Exam 2026 - Session 2 City Slip, Admit Card Date, Question Paper, Answer Key, Cutoff](https://engineering.careers360.com/exams/jee-main): JEE Main exam guide with dates, registration, syllabus, results, cutoffs
- [JEE Advanced Exam 2026: Brochure (Out), Date, Syllabus, Eligibility, Registration, Admit Card, Admission Process](https://engineering.careers360.com/exams/jee-advanced): JEE Advanced exam details: eligibility, dates, syllabus, admission process
- [MHT CET Exam 2026 - Date, City Slip, Admit Card, Syllabus, Sample Papers, Cutoff](https://www.careers360.com/exams/mht-cet): MHT CET Maharashtra entrance exam guide with dates, syllabus, cutoffs
- [AP EAMCET (EAPCET) Exam 2026 - Registration (Started), Dates, Pattern, Sample Papers, Cutoff](https://www.careers360.com/exams/ap-eamcet): AP EAMCET exam guide covering registration, dates, pattern, cutoffs
- [TS EAPCET (EAMCET) Exam 2026: Registration (Started), Date, Syllabus, Pattern, Cutoff, Admission Process](https://www.careers360.com/exams/ts-eamcet): TS EAMCET exam information: dates, syllabus, pattern, counselling process
- [KCET Exam 2026 - Form Correction (Started), Date, Syllabus, Eligibility Criteria, Pattern, Preparation Tips, Cutoff](https://www.careers360.com/exams/kcet): KCET Karnataka entrance exam guide: dates, eligibility, pattern, cutoffs
- [BITSAT Exam 2026 - Application Form, Admit Card, Eligibility Criteria, Syllabus, Sample Papers](https://www.careers360.com/exams/bitsat): BITSAT exam guide for BITS Pilani admissions with syllabus and application info
- [Engineering Entrance Exams in India: Dates, Preparation Tips, Results, Cut-Offs, Colleges Accepting](https://engineering.careers360.com/exams): Hub for engineering entrance exams with dates, preparation tips, results
